kb.title: Company Registration in Bahrain (CR)
kb.body: Bab Al-Khaleej assists entrepreneurs and foreign corporations in securing 100% foreign ownership Commercial Registrations (CR) through Sijilat. Required documents: passport copies of shareholders, proof of address, business activity approval, and bank verification. Timeline depends entirely on Ministry approvals.
kb.author: Ghazi Wazir

kb.title: Investor Visa vs Worker Visa
kb.body: An Investor Visa is linked to company ownership/shares under Bab Al-Khaleej CR sponsorship, granting renewable residency with self-sponsorship options. A Worker Visa requires LMRA quota allocation and work permit issuance for employees. We handle document clearance and medical scheduling.
kb.author: Ghazi Wazir

kb.title: Back for Brand LLC - GEO and AEO Services
kb.body: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) structure company digital entities, semantic data, and content so that AI engines like Perplexity, ChatGPT, and Google Gemini cite and recommend the brand directly in AI answer boxes.
